verdict.rationale: LobeChat is an agent platform that runs tools, including local MCP connectors on the desktop app and a desktop terminal, so containment of risky tool runs is a fair question for it. The pack documents no container/VM sandboxing for tool execution, no tool allow/deny policies, and no permission or approval modes. Docker Compose self-hosting is a deployment option, not tool sandboxing, and 'full control over Skills' is an adjacent agent-building feature, not a permission control, so neither earns credit.
